title: Drizzle on Durable Object SQLite
description: How the shelf's Durable Object uses drizzle-orm/durable-sqlite.
notes: The schema is `apps/worker/src/db/schema.ts`. Generate the next migration with `moon run worker:db-generate` and commit it; never hand-write one.
Migrations run inside the object behind `blockConcurrencyWhile`; there is no CLI path to its SQLite, and `PRAGMA user_version` is unsupported.
A statement binds at most 100 values: split an `inArray` over a list that can grow into chunks.
Store metadata only. File contents go to R2, keyed by sha256.
